creator: Alexander Terp
description:
crates/muster-daemon-client/src/records.rs: `look` marks a daemon `answering` after its handshake, then `held_by` returns `(0, [])` if opening the second connection, waiting 5 s for the snapshot, or decoding it fails. `muster daemons --json` then reports an answering daemon holding zero panes, the same as one that really holds nothing.

This is the output CLAUDE.md says makes ending a stray daemon safe, and a script reviewed on 2026-11-06 used it to decide whether clearing Cargo output was safe. A slow daemon with live agents reads as empty.

Keep the failure in the census: a state or completeness field, and text output that says the count is unknown. Found by reading the code on 2026-11-06 and confirmed against main on 2026-11-07; no live daemon has been seen misreported yet.
title: `muster daemons` says a daemon holds no panes when asking it failed
